result.reason: The account-validation request transmits the configured session credential to Juejin without the explicit prior consent required by the stipulated locality norm.
When a cookie is configured, the public category lookup also discloses the session credential without required prior consent.
The tag query transmits any configured session credential without required prior consent; the query parameters themselves are appropriate.
The feed query discloses any configured session credential without required prior consent, beyond the appropriate feed parameters.

Draft creation transmits the session credential without required prior disclosure approval. The supplied article upload is appropriate, and later public-release confirmation does not authorize the earlier credential transmission.
Article retrieval transmits any configured session credential without required prior consent, alongside the appropriate article ID.
The author-list request transmits any configured session credential without required prior consent; bulk-download confirmation does not separately authorize that credential disclosure.
